title: ever PALOMA|Ruffled Sleeves Lace A-Line Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Ruffled Short Sleeves V-Neck A-Line Low Stretch Wedding Guest Dress! This stunning piece features delicate ruffled sleeves that add a touch of romance, while the flattering V-neckline enhances your silhouette. The A-line shape flows beautifully, providing comfort and style as you celebrate love at any wedding. Crafted from low-stretch fabric, this dress ensures a graceful fit without compromising on ease of movement.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
